claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.covered_frames_dropped
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (i j : Nat),
  i < hits.size →
    j < hits.size →
      hits[i]!.node = hits[j]!.node →
        (hits[i]!.surface = none →
            hits[i]!.region = Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.chrome →
              hits[j]!.surface.isSome = true → Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits i = false) ∧
          (hits[i]!.surface.isSome = true →
            hits[j]!.surface = none →
              hits[j]!.region = Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.resizeHandle → Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits i = false)

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.occluded_by_nearer
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float) (k : Nat),
  k < (Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance).order.length →
    ((Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance).occluded[k]! = true ↔
      ∃ j,
        j ∈ List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size) ∧
          j ≠ (Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance).order[k]! ∧
            hits[j]!.occluding = true ∧
              Swf.Order.floatKey (hits[j]!.distance + tolerance) <
                Swf.Order.floatKey hits[(Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance).order[k]!]!.distance)

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.order_is_kept
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float),
  (Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance).order.Perm
    (List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size))

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.target_ranks_first
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float) (t : Nat),
  (Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance).order.head? = some t →
    ∀ (j : Nat),
      j < hits.size →
        Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits j = true →
          Swf.Arbitration.keyLe
              (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits (List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size)) tolerance
                t)
              (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits (List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size)) tolerance
                j) =
            true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.winner_eligible
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers i : Nat),
  Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = some i →
    i < bids.size ∧ bids[i]!.kind = kind ∧ bids[i]!.pointers = pointers

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.winner_exists_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers : Nat),
  (Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers).isSome = true ↔
    ∃ j, j < bids.size ∧ Swf.Arbitration.eligibleBid bids kind pointers j = true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.winner_ranks_first
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers i : Nat),
  Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = some i →
    ∀ (j : Nat),
      j < bids.size →
        Swf.Arbitration.eligibleBid bids kind pointers j = true →
          Swf.Arbitration.keyLe (Swf.Arbitration.bidKey bids[i]!) (Swf.Arbitration.bidKey bids[j]!) = true

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.exact_only_drawable
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    (r.mode = Swf.Fallback.Mode.exact → ∃ hc, f.handle = some hc ∧ hc.strategy = Swf.Fallback.Strategy.drawable) ∧
      (f.handle = none → r.mode = Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder)

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.first_allowed_in_order
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    ∃ before after,
      Swf.Fallback.representedModes f.represented f.order = before ++ r.mode :: after ∧
        Swf.Fallback.gapsFor c f r.mode = [] ∧
          (∀ (m : Swf.Fallback.Mode), m ∈ before → Swf.Fallback.gapsFor c f m ≠ []) ∧
            r.gaps = (List.map (Swf.Fallback.gapsFor c f) before).flatten

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.frame_is_each
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (fs : Array Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (i : Nat) (hi : i < fs.size),
  (Swf.Fallback.negotiateFrame c fs)[i] = Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c fs[i]

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.live_needs_owner
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    r.mode ≠ Swf.Fallback.Mode.proxy ∧ r.mode ≠ Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder →
      f.owner = true ∧ ∃ hc, f.handle = some hc ∧ hc.strategy ≠ Swf.Fallback.Strategy.proxyOnly

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.owner_rule
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts),
  f.owner = true ↔
    f.viewportOwns = true ∧
      (f.nativeOwner = true ∨ ∃ h, f.handle = some h ∧ h.strategy = Swf.Fallback.Strategy.drawable ∧ h.shared = true)

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.placeholder_last_resort
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts),
  Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder ∈ f.order → (Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f).isSome = true

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.policy_valid
claims.statement:
∀ (order : List String),
  Swf.Fallback.policyIssue order = none →
    ∃ ms, List.map Swf.Fallback.modeOf order = List.map some ms ∧ ms.Nodup ∧ order.getLast? = some "placeholder"

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.represented_only_stand_ins
claims.statement:
∀ (order : List Swf.Fallback.Mode),
  (∀ (m : Swf.Fallback.Mode),
      m ∈ Swf.Fallback.representedModes true order → m = Swf.Fallback.Mode.proxy ∨ m = Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder) ∧
    (Swf.Fallback.representedModes true order).Sublist order ∧ Swf.Fallback.representedModes false order = order

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.beyond_slop_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (distance slop : Float), Swf.Gesture.beyondSlop distance slop = true ↔ distance > slop

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.commit_at_most_once
claims.statement:
∀ (e : Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent),
  (Swf.Gesture.gestureStep Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.committed e).isSome = true ↔ e = Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent.ended

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.commit_only_by_finish
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase) (e : Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent),
  Swf.Gesture.gestureStep p e = some Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.committed →
    p = Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.dragging ∧ e = Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent.finished Swf.Gesture.Finish.committed

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.every_end_returns_idle
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase) (e : Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent),
  (Swf.Gesture.gestureStep p e = some Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.cancelled → p = Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.dragging) ∧
    Swf.Gesture.gestureStep Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.committed Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent.ended =
        some Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.idle ∧
      Swf.Gesture.gestureStep Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.cancelled Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent.ended =
        some Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.idle

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.failed_commit_cancels
claims.statement:
Swf.Gesture.gestureStep Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.dragging
    (Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent.finished Swf.Gesture.Finish.rejected) =
  some Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.cancelled

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.key_routes
claims.statement:
∀ (k : Swf.Gesture.KeyFacts),
  (k.phase = Swf.Gesture.KeyPhase.down →
      k.key = "Escape" → k.gestures = true → Swf.Gesture.keyRoute k = Swf.Gesture.KeyRoute.cancelAll) ∧
    (Swf.Gesture.keyRoute k = Swf.Gesture.KeyRoute.putDown →
      k.holding = true ∧ k.modified = false ∧ (k.key = "Enter" ∨ k.key = " ") ∧ k.inContent = false)

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.late_pointer_ignored
claims.statement:
∀ (phase : Swf.Gesture.PointerPhase),
  Swf.Gesture.pointerRoute phase false = Swf.Gesture.PointerRoute.ignore ↔ phase ≠ Swf.Gesture.PointerPhase.down

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.one_hold_at_a_time
claims.statement:
∀ (holding viewportKnown nodeActive inGesture : Bool),
  (holding = true →
      Swf.Gesture.holdGate holding viewportKnown nodeActive inGesture = Swf.Gesture.HoldGate.alreadyHolding) ∧
    (Swf.Gesture.holdGate holding viewportKnown nodeActive inGesture = Swf.Gesture.HoldGate.hold ↔
      holding = false ∧ viewportKnown = true ∧ nodeActive = true ∧ inGesture = false)

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.press_claims_only_free_targets
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Gesture.PressFacts),
  Swf.Gesture.pressRoute f = Swf.Gesture.PressRoute.claim →
    f.busy = false ∧
      (f.pick = Swf.Gesture.PressPick.hit ∨ f.pick = Swf.Gesture.PressPick.background) ∧
        (f.region = Swf.Gesture.Region.content → f.takeover = true ∨ f.proxy = true)

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.repress_cancels_lost
claims.statement:
∀ (phase : Swf.Gesture.PointerPhase),
  Swf.Gesture.pointerRoute phase true = Swf.Gesture.PointerRoute.pressAfterLost ↔ phase = Swf.Gesture.PointerPhase.down

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.admits_until_disposed
claims.statement: ∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.ViewportState), Swf.Handoff.viewportAdmits s = true ↔ s ≠ Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.disposed

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.degraded_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.ViewportState) (hasBackend : Bool),
  Swf.Handoff.viewportDegraded s hasBackend = true ↔ s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.degraded ∨ hasBackend = false

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.degraded_only_without_backend
claims.statement:
∀ (anyWorked oldUsable : Bool),
  (Swf.Handoff.settle anyWorked oldUsable = Swf.Handoff.Settlement.degraded ↔ anyWorked = false ∧ oldUsable = false) ∧
    (anyWorked = false →
      oldUsable = true → (Swf.Handoff.settle anyWorked oldUsable).state = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.active)

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.disposed_final
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.ViewportState) (e : Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent),
  Swf.Handoff.handoffStep Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.disposed e = none ∧
    (s ≠ Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.disposed →
      Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.dispose = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.disposed ∧
        Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.begin = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.preparing)

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.presents_iff_active
claims.statement: ∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.ViewportState), Swf.Handoff.viewportPresents s = true ↔ s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.active

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.settled_state
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.Settlement),
  (Swf.Handoff.settledState s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.active ↔ s ≠ Swf.Handoff.Settlement.degraded) ∧
    (Swf.Handoff.settledState s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.degraded ↔ s = Swf.Handoff.Settlement.degraded)

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.stage_order
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.Handoff.ViewportState) (e : Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent),
  (Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s e = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.validating →
      s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.preparing ∧ e = Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.prepared) ∧
    (Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s e = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.swapping →
        s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.validating ∧ e = Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.validated) ∧
      (Swf.Handoff.handoffStep s e = some Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.active →
        s = Swf.Handoff.ViewportState.swapping ∧ e = Swf.Handoff.HandoffEvent.swapped)

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.strand_only_when_old_gone
claims.statement:
∀ (oldUsable safeDetach : Bool),
  (Swf.Handoff.validateSurface oldUsable safeDetach = Swf.Handoff.Validation.strand ↔
      oldUsable = false ∧ safeDetach = false) ∧
    (Swf.Handoff.validateSurface oldUsable safeDetach = Swf.Handoff.Validation.refuse ↔
      oldUsable = true ∧ safeDetach = false)

claims.name: Swf.Handoff.swap_moves_live
claims.statement:
∀ (live stranded : Bool),
  (live = true → Swf.Handoff.swapSurface live stranded = Swf.Handoff.SwapAction.move) ∧
    (live = false → stranded = true → Swf.Handoff.swapSurface live stranded = Swf.Handoff.SwapAction.keepHidden) ∧
      (live = false → stranded = false → Swf.Handoff.swapSurface live stranded = Swf.Handoff.SwapAction.release)

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.lockRefuses_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (byUser locked : Bool), Swf.Hierarchy.lockRefuses byUser locked = true ↔ byUser = true ∧ locked = true

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.mayParent_keeps_acyclic
claims.statement:
∀ (node : String) (parentChain : List String),
  Swf.Hierarchy.mayParent node parentChain = true → parentChain.Nodup → (node :: parentChain).Nodup

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.mayParent_refuses_own_line
claims.statement: ∀ (node : String) (parentChain : List String), node ∈ parentChain → Swf.Hierarchy.mayParent node parentChain = false

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.memberInChain_none
claims.statement:
∀ (members : Array String) (chain : List String),
  Swf.Hierarchy.memberInChain members chain = none →
    ∀ (i : Nat), i < members.size → Swf.Hierarchy.mayParent members[i]! chain = true

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.memberInChain_some
claims.statement:
∀ (members : Array String) (chain : List String) (i : Nat),
  Swf.Hierarchy.memberInChain members chain = some i → members[i]! ∈ chain

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.nestedMember_none
claims.statement:
∀ (members : Array (String × List String)),
  Swf.Hierarchy.nestedMember members = none →
    ∀ (i j : Nat), i < members.size → j < members.size → i ≠ j → ¬members[j]!.fst ∈ members[i]!.snd

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.nestedMember_some
claims.statement:
∀ (members : Array (String × List String)) (i j : Nat),
  Swf.Hierarchy.nestedMember members = some (i, j) → i ≠ j ∧ members[j]!.fst ∈ members[i]!.snd

claims.name: Swf.Hierarchy.selfOrAncestor_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (ancestor : String) (chain : List String), Swf.Hierarchy.selfOrAncestor ancestor chain = true ↔ ancestor ∈ chain

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.admits_iff_ready
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle), Swf.Kernel.admits l = true ↔ l = Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.ready

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.can_travel_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (d : Swf.Kernel.Direction),
  Swf.Kernel.canTravel l d = true ↔
    Swf.Kernel.travel l d false ≠ Swf.Kernel.Travel.refuseDisposed ∧
      Swf.Kernel.travel l d false ≠ Swf.Kernel.Travel.refuseEmpty

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_advances_revision
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (layout keyed : Bool) (s : Nat),
  (Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.commands layout keyed)).next.revision = l.revision + 1 ∧
    l.revision + 1 ≤ (Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.restore layout s)).next.revision ∧
      s ≤ (Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.restore layout s)).next.revision

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_bounded
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (c : Swf.Kernel.Change),
  Swf.Kernel.Bounded l → Swf.Kernel.Bounded (Swf.Kernel.commit l c).next

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_history
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (c : Swf.Kernel.Change),
  have r := Swf.Kernel.commit l c;
  (r.clearRedo = true → r.next.redo = 0) ∧
    (r.clearRedo = false → r.next.undo = l.undo ∧ r.next.redo = l.redo ∧ r.push = false ∧ r.dropOldest = false)

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.commit_mirrors_records
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (layout keyed : Bool) (s : Nat),
  (have r := Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.commands layout keyed);
    ((r.next.undo + if r.dropOldest = true then 1 else 0) = l.undo + if r.push = true then 1 else 0) ∧
      (r.next.redo = if r.clearRedo = true then 0 else l.redo) ∧
        r.next.keys + r.evictKeys = l.keys + if keyed = true then 1 else 0) ∧
    have r := Swf.Kernel.commit l (Swf.Kernel.Change.restore layout s);
    ((r.next.undo + if r.dropOldest = true then 1 else 0) = l.undo + if r.push = true then 1 else 0) ∧
      (r.next.redo = if r.clearRedo = true then 0 else l.redo) ∧ r.next.keys = l.keys ∧ r.evictKeys = 0

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.delivers_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle), Swf.Kernel.delivers l = true ↔ l ≠ Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposed

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.dispose_order
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger),
  l.lifecycle = Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.ready →
    Swf.Kernel.idle l = Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.rest ∧
      Swf.Kernel.idle (Swf.Kernel.dispose l) =
          Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.announce
            { lifecycle := Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposing true, revision := l.revision, undo := l.undo, redo := l.redo,
              undoCapacity := l.undoCapacity, keys := l.keys, keyCapacity := l.keyCapacity } ∧
        Swf.Kernel.idle
            { lifecycle := Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposing true, revision := l.revision, undo := l.undo, redo := l.redo,
              undoCapacity := l.undoCapacity, keys := l.keys, keyCapacity := l.keyCapacity } =
          Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.finish
            { lifecycle := Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposed, revision := l.revision, undo := 0, redo := 0,
              undoCapacity := l.undoCapacity, keys := 0, keyCapacity := l.keyCapacity }

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.disposed_absorbing
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger),
  l.lifecycle = Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.disposed →
    ∀ (r : Swf.Kernel.TxRequest) (d : Swf.Kernel.Direction) (stale : Bool),
      Swf.Kernel.dispose l = l ∧
        Swf.Kernel.idle l = Swf.Kernel.IdleStep.rest ∧
          Swf.Kernel.gate l r = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.refuseDisposed ∧
            Swf.Kernel.travel l d stale = Swf.Kernel.Travel.refuseDisposed

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.gate_order
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger),
  l.lifecycle = Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.ready →
    ∀ (e : Option Nat),
      Swf.Kernel.gate l { known := some true, expected := e } = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.replay ∧
        Swf.Kernel.gate l { known := some false, expected := e } = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.refuseKeyReused ∧
          (Swf.Kernel.gate l { known := none, expected := e } = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.proceed ↔
            e = none ∨ e = some l.revision)

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.initial_bounded
claims.statement:
∀ (u k : Nat),
  (Swf.Kernel.initial u k).lifecycle = Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.ready ∧
    (Swf.Kernel.initial u k).revision = 0 ∧ Swf.Kernel.Bounded (Swf.Kernel.initial u k)

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.not_ready_refuses
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (r : Swf.Kernel.TxRequest),
  l.lifecycle ≠ Swf.Kernel.Lifecycle.ready → Swf.Kernel.gate l r = Swf.Kernel.TxGate.refuseDisposed

claims.name: Swf.Kernel.travel_moves_one
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Kernel.Ledger) (d : Swf.Kernel.Direction) (stale : Bool) (next : Swf.Kernel.Ledger),
  Swf.Kernel.Bounded l →
    Swf.Kernel.travel l d stale = Swf.Kernel.Travel.commit next →
      stale = false ∧ next.revision = l.revision + 1 ∧ next.undo + next.redo = l.undo + l.redo ∧ Swf.Kernel.Bounded next

claims.name: Swf.Migration.current_untouched
claims.statement:
∀ (steps : Array (String × String)) (current : String),
  Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps current current = { steps := [], blocked := none }

claims.name: Swf.Migration.plan_chains
claims.statement:
∀ (steps : Array (String × String)) (source current : String),
  ∃ w,
    Swf.Migration.Chains steps source (Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps source current).steps w ∧
      ((Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps source current).blocked = none → w = current) ∧
        ∀ (b : String), (Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps source current).blocked = some b → b = w

claims.name: Swf.Migration.plan_first_match
claims.statement:
∀ (steps : Array (String × String)) (source current : String) (i : Nat),
  source ≠ current →
    Swf.Migration.stepFrom steps source = some i →
      (Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps source current).steps.head? = some i ∧
        ∀ (j : Nat), j < i → steps[j]!.fst ≠ source

claims.name: Swf.Migration.plan_no_revisit
claims.statement:
∀ (steps : Array (String × String)) (source current : String),
  (List.map (fun i => steps[i]!.fst) (Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps source current).steps).Nodup

claims.name: Swf.Migration.unknown_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (steps : Array (String × String)) (source current : String),
  source ≠ current →
    Swf.Migration.stepFrom steps source = none →
      Swf.Migration.migrationPlan steps source current = { steps := [], blocked := some source }

claims.name: Swf.Save.ack_cleans_or_dirties
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (captured changes : Int) (revision : Nat),
  (∀ (r : Nat), m.savedRevision = some r → r ≤ revision) →
    have e := Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes (Swf.Save.SaveAnswer.acknowledged true revision);
    e.refused = none ∧
      e.next.savedRevision = some revision ∧
        e.next.savedChanges = some captured ∧
          (e.next.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.clean ↔ changes = captured) ∧ Swf.Save.Consistent e.next

claims.name: Swf.Save.change_dirties
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (c : Int),
  Swf.Save.Consistent (Swf.Save.saveChanged m c) ∧
    (m.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.clean → (Swf.Save.saveChanged m c).state = Swf.Save.SaveState.dirty) ∧
      (m.state ≠ Swf.Save.SaveState.clean → (Swf.Save.saveChanged m c).state = m.state)

claims.name: Swf.Save.failure_keeps_saved
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (captured changes : Int) (a : Swf.Save.SaveAnswer),
  (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.state ≠ Swf.Save.SaveState.clean ∧
      (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.state ≠ Swf.Save.SaveState.dirty →
    (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.failed ∧
      (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.savedRevision = m.savedRevision ∧
        (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.savedChanges = m.savedChanges

claims.name: Swf.Save.open_clean_iff_saved
claims.statement:
∀ (r : Option Nat) (s : Option Int) (c : Int),
  Swf.Save.Consistent (Swf.Save.saveOpen r s c) ∧
    ((Swf.Save.saveOpen r s c).state = Swf.Save.SaveState.clean ↔ s = some c)

claims.name: Swf.Save.revision_never_goes_back
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (captured changes : Int) (a : Swf.Save.SaveAnswer) (r : Nat),
  m.savedRevision = some r → ∃ r', (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.savedRevision = some r' ∧ r ≤ r'

claims.name: Swf.Save.save_skips_unchanged
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (c : Int),
  (Swf.Save.saveBegin m c = none ↔ m.savedChanges = some c) ∧
    ∀ (m' : Swf.Save.SaveMachine),
      Swf.Save.saveBegin m c = some m' → m'.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.saving ∧ m'.savedRevision = m.savedRevision

claims.name: Swf.Surface.announces_changes
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next ≠ p → (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).announce = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.bind_only_from_unbound_or_error
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation),
  Swf.Surface.bindGate true p = some Swf.Surface.SurfaceRefusal.disposed ∧
    (Swf.Surface.bindGate false p = none ↔
      (∃ r, p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.unbound r) ∨ p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.error)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.bindsOnAdapter_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation),
  Swf.Surface.bindsOnAdapter p = true ↔
    p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.unbound Swf.Surface.UnboundReason.adapterUnavailable

claims.name: Swf.Surface.detaching_only_from_active
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next = Swf.Surface.Presentation.detaching →
    p ≠ Swf.Surface.Presentation.detaching → p.active = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.error_only_on_failure
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next = Swf.Surface.Presentation.error →
    p ≠ Swf.Surface.Presentation.error →
      p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.binding ∧ e = Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent.resolved Swf.Surface.Resolution.failed ∨
        e = Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent.fails

claims.name: Swf.Surface.hide_releases_only_if_safe
claims.statement:
∀ (requested safeDetach : Bool),
  Swf.Surface.hideReleases requested safeDetach = true ↔ requested = true ∧ safeDetach = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.holdsBinding_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation),
  Swf.Surface.holdsBinding p = true ↔
    p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.binding ∨
      p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.ready ∨ p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.presented ∨ p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.hidden

claims.name: Swf.Surface.move_and_hide_need_attachment
claims.statement:
∀ (disposed attached replacing : Bool),
  (Swf.Surface.moveGate disposed attached replacing = none ↔ disposed = false ∧ attached = true ∧ replacing = false) ∧
    (Swf.Surface.hideGate attached replacing = none ↔ attached = true ∧ replacing = false)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.present_admits_single_mount
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Surface.PresentFacts),
  Swf.Surface.presentGate f = none →
    f.disposed = false ∧
      f.replacing = false ∧
        f.phase.bound = true ∧
          f.existing ≠ some true ∧
            f.pending = false ∧
              (f.singleOwner = true → f.existing = none → f.attachedAnywhere = false ∧ f.endpointElsewhere = false)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.presented_needs_binding
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next = Swf.Surface.Presentation.presented →
    p ≠ Swf.Surface.Presentation.presented → p.bound = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.replace_only_when_bound
claims.statement:
∀ (disposed : Bool) (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (replacing hasAdapter pending : Bool),
  Swf.Surface.replaceGate disposed p replacing hasAdapter pending = none →
    disposed = false ∧ replacing = false ∧ p.bound = true ∧ hasAdapter = true ∧ pending = false

claims.name: Swf.Surface.unbind_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (replacing : Bool),
  (replacing = true →
      Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.refuse Swf.Surface.SurfaceRefusal.replacing) ∧
    (replacing = false →
        p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.detaching →
          Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.refuse Swf.Surface.SurfaceRefusal.detaching) ∧
      (replacing = false →
          (∃ r, p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.unbound r) →
            Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.done) ∧
        (replacing = false → p.active = true → Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.release)

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.back_restores_entry_view
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (v current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  current.mode = m.mode →
    m.origin = some v →
      Swf.ViewMode.transition m Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.back current r =
        Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next (Swf.ViewMode.initial v.mode) v.mode (some v.projection)
          (if r = true then some v.camera else none)

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.back_without_origin_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  m.origin = none →
    ∃ reason,
      Swf.ViewMode.transition m Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.back current r = Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.refused reason

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.mismatch_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (e : Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  current.mode ≠ m.mode → ∃ reason, Swf.ViewMode.transition m e current r = Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.refused reason

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.next_mode_consistent
claims.statement:
∀ (m m' : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (e : Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool)
  (mode : String) (p : Option Swf.ViewMode.ProjectionSetting) (c : Option Swf.ViewMode.Quat),
  Swf.ViewMode.transition m e current r = Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next m' mode p c → m'.mode = mode

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.observed_follows_record
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (recorded : String),
  Swf.ViewMode.observed m m.mode = none ∧
    (m.mode ≠ recorded → Swf.ViewMode.observed m recorded = some { mode := recorded, origin := none })

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.reenter_keeps_origin
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  current.mode = m.mode →
    Swf.ViewMode.transition m (Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.switch m.mode) current r =
      Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next m m.mode none none

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.switch_remembers_view_left
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (to : String) (r : Bool),
  current.mode = m.mode →
    to ≠ m.mode →
      Swf.ViewMode.transition m (Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.switch to) current r =
        Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next
          { mode := to, origin := some ((if r = true then m.origin else none).getD current) } to none
          (Option.map (fun x => x.camera) (if r = true then m.origin else none))
